priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns an empty disposer after line 2 registers the handler. The base version called socket.off("message", handler), so invoking cleanup now leaves the callback active and repeated attach/dispose cycles retain and duplicate listeners.
